references.text: The Lord watches over the foreigner; he upholds the fatherless and the widow, but he frustrates the way of the wicked.
Do you not know? Have you not heard? The Lord is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He does not faint or grow weary; his understanding is unsearchable.
"Do I not fill heaven and earth?" declares the Lord.
Are not five sparrows sold for two assaria? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God. Indeed, even the hairs of your head are all numbered. Do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
